description: Remove support for the pyzbar/libzbar barcode reader from the system, consolidating all barcode reading functionality to use zxing-cpp exclusively. This will simplify the codebase by eliminating configuration options and tests specific to the legacy reader while maintaining the same barcode reading capabilities through the improved zxing-cpp implementation.
functional_requirements: Remove all code that handles pyzbar/libzbar barcode reading, including configuration switches and conditional logic
Update all configuration files and documentation to remove references to the legacy barcode reader option
Remove all tests that were specific to pyzbar/libzbar functionality while preserving tests for zxing-cpp
Update dependency management to remove pyzbar and related dependencies from the project
